value.name: family dinner turns emotional
value.description: At the dinner table, Lucia laughs, cries a little, and laughs again while Daniel briefly comforts her and Asha looks away.
evidence: made Lucia put down her fork and laugh and then, a moment later, cry a little, and then laugh again
Daniel reached across the table and put his hand briefly on his sister's wrist
Asha looked down at her plate

value.name: family moves to the parlor
value.description: After dinner, the group relocates to the parlor and settles into a quieter domestic scene.
evidence: After dinner they moved back to the parlor.

value.name: Rosa serves coffee
value.description: Rosa brings coffee into the parlor for everyone.
evidence: Rosa brought coffee.

value.name: Daniel tends the fire
value.description: Daniel adds another log to the fire, reinforcing the room's warm, settled atmosphere.
evidence: Daniel put another log on the fire.

value.name: Lucia resumes familiar floor seat
value.description: Lucia sits on the floor against the couch in a posture Asha reads as deeply familiar and newly restored.
evidence: Lucia sat on the floor with her back against the couch
which Asha suspected was a position she had sat in, in this room, since she was a child
Tonight the room was full of none of those things.

value.name: Asha notices the room's changed atmosphere
value.description: Asha observes that the parlor is no longer crowded with paperwork and grief, only with people, fire, coffee, and a ticking clock.
evidence: which she had perhaps not been able to sit in for some weeks because the room had been too full of paperwork and grief and her brother
Tonight the room was full of none of those things. It was full of four people and a fire and the smell of coffee and the slow ticking of a clock on the mantel that Asha had not previously noticed.

value.name: Asha prepares to leave
value.description: At 9:30, Asha says she should go, and the others do not try to keep her longer.
evidence: At nine-thirty Asha said she should go.
No one argued

value.name: Rosa affirms Asha's place
value.description: Rosa tells Asha to come back as a person rather than as a project, and Asha agrees.
evidence: Rosa, from the parlor, called, "Come again, Asha. Not as a project. As a person."
"I will."
"Good."

value.name: Daniel escorts Asha to the door
value.description: Daniel walks Asha to the door as she leaves the parlor.
evidence: Lucia got her coat. Daniel walked her to the door.

value.name: Daniel apologizes for his behavior
value.description: On the stoop, Daniel admits he was not easy and begins to acknowledge his difficult behavior.
evidence: On the stoop Daniel paused.
"Asha."
"Yes."
"I was not easy."
"You were not."
"I know that. I want to say, for the record, that I know that."

value.name: snow begins falling again
value.description: As Daniel and Asha stand outside, light snow starts up again and dusts the railings.
evidence: The snow had started again, very lightly, just enough to powder the railings.
